verdicts.reason: A rearranges for the shorter banner: the headline is larger and the date/venue block is rewrapped into a neat right-aligned three-line stack. But 'Sunday' nearly touches the window graphic, and the window runs almost to the top and bottom edges, so it looks cramped. B is just a shrunken copy: the whole group is crowded into the middle with big empty margins on both sides, and the date/venue line is tiny and hard to read at this size, so the headline and details lose their impact.
